en: A colorized historic postcard view of a large central square bordered by multi-story buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the middle of the square stands a prominent monument surrounded by steps and small statues, with people, carriages, and market stalls scattered around. Behind the square rises a green hill topped by a clock tower and fortification walls. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Graz. Hauptplatz mit Schlossberg."
